output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS de_q4_2025_net_revenue_eur
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c
  ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE
  AND c.country = 'DE'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-10-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: Revenue is net_revenue of orders with is_revenue = true (status completed). Customers in Germany are identified by dim_customers.country = 'DE', joined to fct_orders on customer_id. Q4 2025 is filtered on order_date from 2025-10-01 up to but excluding 2026-01-01. The result is one row with the total net revenue in EUR, rounded to 2 decimals.
